features.name: Looping sound catalog
features.description: A bundled library of seamlessly looping ambient sounds grouped by theme: rain, water, nature, household appliances, transport, and color noises (white, pink, brown, blue, violet). Each sound has a thumbnail and plays as a gapless loop.
features.reason: This is the heart of the app. Color noises can be generated procedurally. Nature and appliance sounds must be original or royalty-free recordings bundled in the app, never the original app's files.

features.name: Now-playing player
features.description: A full-screen player showing the current sound's image and name, with favorite, previous, play/pause, next and info buttons, a volume slider, and an AirPlay route picker. Swiping left or right moves through the catalog.
features.reason: This is the primary interaction surface.

features.name: Background audio and remote controls
features.description: Playback continues when the app is backgrounded or the screen is locked. Lock screen, Control Center, Bluetooth and headphone controls are supported through MPNowPlayingInfoCenter and MPRemoteCommandCenter.
features.reason: It is essential for overnight use and needs no network.

features.name: Favorites
features.description: Heart any sound or mix to pin it to a Favorites list for quick access.
features.reason: It is simple, local, and expected by users.

features.name: Sleep timer with fade-out
features.description: A countdown, either as a duration or a clock time, that gradually fades the volume over a chosen period and then stops playback.
features.reason: It is the main bedtime use case and can be built with AVAudioEngine volume ramps.

features.name: Fade-in alarm
features.description: An alarm set by duration or clock time, with a repeat schedule, a choice of alarm sound, and a fade-in length (for example 30 seconds) so the user wakes gently. It also offers snooze with a custom snooze length.
features.reason: It is a headline feature of the paid app. Reliability depends on the app staying alive while it plays sleep audio, so use a local notification as a fallback, or AlarmKit where it is available.

features.name: Mix Pad
features.description: A 2D canvas with a listener icon in the center. Each sound in the mix is a draggable circle. Left/right position sets stereo pan and distance from the center sets loudness. Each layer also has controls for pitch, volume and random variance (gentle volume drift), and layers can be added or removed. Mixes are saved as their own entries in the catalog.
features.reason: It is a key differentiator and maps well to AVAudioEngine with one player node per layer.

features.name: Record and loop your own sound
features.description: Record from the microphone with a large tap-to-start/stop button and a circular progress ring. The app trims the recording and crossfades its ends so it loops without a click, then saves it into the catalog.
features.reason: The listing promotes it prominently. It needs only microphone permission and stays fully on-device.

features.name: Playlists
features.description: An ordered list of sounds or mixes, each with its own play duration (for example 10 minutes or 1 hour). Supports a shuffle option, reordering, editing, adding items, and looping the whole playlist.
features.reason: It is shown in the screenshots and is purely local.

features.name: Nightstand clock
features.description: A full-screen dim digital clock showing the time, the date and the next alarm. The digit color and brightness are adjustable, and the screen is kept awake while it is open.
features.reason: It is a common bedside use and simple to build.

features.name: Sound generator
features.description: Procedurally generate custom color noise using a spectral tilt slider, binaural beats from two tone frequencies, and pure tones, then save the results as catalog entries.
features.reason: It is a paid add-on in the original and easy to build with AVAudioSourceNode. Offering it free is a strong differentiator.

features.name: Music library as alarm or mix-in
features.description: Use a song from the user's local music library as an alarm sound that fades in, or play music alongside the noise.
features.reason: It works locally with MPMediaPickerController, but adds a permission prompt and only covers non-DRM local items.

features.name: Advanced playback settings
features.description: Global balance, pitch, and a toggle to allow mixing with audio from other apps.
features.reason: It is a low-cost polish item.

features.name: Export and share a mix or recording
features.description: Export a mix definition or a rendered audio file through the system share sheet, and import mix files from Files.
features.reason: It works file-based with no server. It replaces the original's online sharing.

features.name: Online sound market (download and upload)
features.description: Browse, download and upload community sounds and mixes from a web marketplace.
features.reason: It needs a server, network access and likely an account.

features.name: Apple TV and Apple Watch apps
features.reason: It is outside the single-utility iPhone scope. A Watch remote would also need syncing.

features.name: Ads and rating or market prompts
features.description: Advertising and nag prompts present in the free tier of the original.
features.reason: Sbu apps have no ads and no nags.

flows.name: Fall asleep to a sound
steps: Open the app; the player shows the last sound
Swipe or use next to pick a sound, for example rain
Tap play; audio loops gaplessly
Open Timers, add a timer set to stop sound after 1 hour with a 30-second fade, and save
Lock the phone; audio keeps playing, then fades and stops on schedule

flows.name: Set a gentle wake alarm
steps: Open Timers and tap Add
Choose the sound alarm event, set Clock mode and pick 7:00
Pick an alarm sound and a fade-in length, and set repeat to weekdays
Save; the alarm appears in the list and on the nightstand clock
At alarm time the sleep audio crossfades into the alarm sound, rising slowly
The user taps Snooze or Stop

flows.name: Create a mix
steps: Tap Create, then New Mix
Tap + and choose a sound, for example a campfire; a token appears on the canvas
Add more layers such as thunder, waves and jungle
Drag tokens left or right for pan and closer or farther for volume
Tap a token to adjust its pitch and variance
Tap Done, name the mix and save it; it appears in the catalog and starts playing

flows.name: Record a custom loop
steps: Tap Create, then Record Sound, and grant microphone permission on first use
Tap the big button to start; the ring shows the elapsed time
Tap again to stop
The app trims and crossfades the ends and plays a looping preview
Name the sound and save it to the catalog, or tap Reset to retry

flows.name: Build a playlist
steps: Tap Create, then New Playlist
Tap + to add sounds or mixes
Tap the adjust icon on each row to set its duration
Reorder rows in Edit mode and toggle shuffle or loop
Play; items advance automatically with a short crossfade

flows.name: Nightstand mode
steps: Tap the Sleep tab
The full-screen clock appears and the screen stays awake
Tap to reveal controls and adjust color and brightness
Audio and alarms keep running underneath

data_model.storage: SwiftData for metadata (sounds, mixes, playlists, timers). Recorded and generated audio files go in Application Support, and Settings in UserDefaults. Bundled loops ship in the app as original or royalty-free CAF/M4A files. Everything stays on device, with no network entitlement needed.

monetization.model: Free, with no ads, in-app purchases, subscription or account
monetization.notes: The original costs a one-off 0,99 € and sells the noise/tone generator as an extra in-app purchase. Its free tier has ads and market prompts. The Sbu version includes the full catalog, mixing, recording, playlists, alarms and the generator for free, and drops the online market and the companion TV/Watch apps.
